name: groundwork
description: Codex-native personal R&D workflow base for PRD, task slicing, planning, prototypes, implementation, verification, and handoff.

interface.shortDescription: A personal R&D base for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Groundwork is a Codex-native personal R&D base for turning PRD/spec intent into managed tasks, grounding execution in project evidence, selecting the lightest execution path, and producing verified deliverables.
defaultPrompt: Use Groundwork only when context, risk, or reuse justifies a workflow.
Use Groundwork dispatch to route accepted ready tasks without executing them.
Use Groundwork to verify an issue or prepare a handoff.
